title: 皐月賞の後に・魂は同じ色

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fight for first place in the Satsuki Sho is more intense than we could've predicted, and Tamamo Cross loses out on the crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she finds an unlikely friend in Gold City, whose flashy looks also make her a target. Recognizing each other's skills, the two vow to keep fighting in future races.
